scene: The circular lamp room at the top of a lighthouse at night, brass lens assembly turning slowly

subjects.description: A young woman with long red braided hair, pale freckled skin and a dark green hooded wool cloak, hood down
subjects.position: lower left, kneeling on the iron floor
subjects.action: unrolling a hand-drawn map and pinning it with the brass compass
subjects.pose: kneeling, bent over the map, face lit from below, profile view

subjects.description: The map shows a coastline with an island marked by a red X and the handwritten label "SKERRY VAULT"

style: painterly cinematic concept art, visible brush texture, storyboard key frame
lighting: rotating warm lamp light sweeping across the room, cool blue night outside the glass, the map lit by a hurricane lantern
background: curved glass panes with rain, the great fresnel lens, iron spiral stairs descending
composition: medium shot from slightly above, circular room suggested by the curved glass, map in the foreground

camera.angle: high angle, looking down over her shoulder
camera.depth_of_field: moderate, map sharp, lens assembly slightly soft
